title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Ian Heath Gershengorn is chair of the Jenner & Block’s Appellate and Supreme Court Practice and is one of the Nation’s premier Supreme Court and appellate advocates, having argued 16 cases in the U.S. Supreme Court.
